before_public_upload_gate: Root review of actual frozen source/scope
Complete root-selected sealed and external pin closure
Classify every raw credential candidate using filename/hash-only reports; do not expose secret values
Resolve unstable/missing selected source nodes with explicit capture epoch or truthful retained classification
Bounded decoded-container secret scan or explicit reviewed exclusion classification for every opaque container; no raw-only secret-free claim
Confirm selected release prefix absent and exact new dataset identity; root authorizes remote creation/upload
Independent chunk/path reconstruction and all shard SHA validation before publication
credential_controls.complete_PEM_bounds: Body lines <=4096 bytes and <=512 lines, with matching END type. Cross-chunk retained prefix 64KiB; exotic larger key encodings not fully covered and no universal secret-free claim.
credential_controls.credential_candidates: exclude raw whole-file content from public shards before committing newly staged chunks; retain file digest/path and match digest only; original sealed bytes unchanged
credential_controls.metadata_candidates: private raw path/index metadata, public digest-only metadata derivative
credential_controls.opaque_compressed_containers: magic and not-performed inner-scan recorded; raw byte scan does not qualify recursively compressed content
credential_controls.scan: Raw streams and 64KiB cross-chunk overlap; complete newline-delimited private-key PEM blocks rather than isolated BEGIN constants; known GitHub/HF formats and exact available credential values; no matched values in outputs

custody.all_source_regular_reads: O_NOFOLLOW + before/after FD identity/stat + matching final path lstat; source.resolve refuses parent symlinks
custody.capture_failures: retain partial new output and actual primary error type; outer wrapper must retain import/argument/pre-try/setup/cancellation status and logs
custody.changed_later: retain valid file-specific captured snapshot and explicit added/deleted/changed later drift; append capture epoch can cover later current bytes
custody.compression_child: one own process group, bounded wait and own PG cleanup on error; no unrelated process cleanup
custody.sealed_and_external_pin_closure: mandatory complete root-selected exact file pins before/after; DRAFT intentionally fails closed until supplied
custody.unstable_during_read: retain unresolved metadata after retries; no false content SHA or byte claim

format.deduplication: raw SHA256 chunks shared across all selected namespaces; each unique clean chunk stored once
format.member_codec: zstd level1 individual raw chunks in ordinary tar members chunks/<SHA>.zst
format.mode_uid_gid_times: original node modes/uid/gid/timestamps retained as metadata; normalized tar member metadata is not original filesystem metadata
format.path_encoding: ASCII JSON escaping retains surrogateescaped POSIX paths; source byte contents opaque
format.regular_file_binding: ordered chunk SHA256/length list and full raw file SHA256/bytes; exact all-file-path membership retained
format.special_nodes: retain type/rdev/mode/stat only; never open or reconstruct
format.symlinks: retain link text/hash/length without following; credential-bearing target text remains private

resource_plan.private_disk_usage: SQLite path index plus at most one stable-file staged compressed chunks and one <=252MiB tar in progress; final compressed archive bytes remain local for upload

scope_accounting.publication_admin_selfreferences: selected root inventory administration paths retained as metadata only; new archives/private ledgers excluded from self recursion
